front.title: Media over QUIC Transport (MOQT) Object Acknowledgements

abstract.t: This document defines an extension to Media over QUIC Transport (MOQT) that allows a subscriber to explicitly acknowledge receiving and processing an incoming object. The acknowledgement includes a time delta indicating how early or late the object arrived relative to an application-specified deadline; the subscriber also provides the publisher with the reference window size that can be used to interpret the time delta. A mechanism to negotiate support for the extension, both on the connection and the subscription level, is also defined.
